summary: The opt-in web publisher admits configured tailnet tags as distinct read-only preview identities using a dedicated, startup-scope-checked tag-reader credential, including the collections read WebSocket, while keeping browser pairing login-only and stripping identity headers before the daemon gateway.

compatibility.detail: Tag admission is opt-in through WF_TAILNET_TAGS; ambiguous login-plus-tag headers fail closed.

manual.detail: To enable tagged previews, configure WF_TAILNET_TAGS behind an identity-stripping filter and provide a dedicated read.*-only grant in WF_TAG_AUTHORIZATION_FILE; restart the publisher. The startup capabilities check rejects write, control, pairing and all terminal scopes.

recovery.detail: Unset WF_TAILNET_TAGS to disable tag admission.
